Brushwork, paint behaviour and palette details are read live from Creative_Inspiration/Style_Profiles/<id>*.md at prompt time; `sources` names those profiles. `avoid_drop` removes profile avoid items that clash with Tony's 'never vector-looking' rule.

cards.name: Linework Silhouette
cards.paint: Flat matte shapes filled with hand-drawn contour stripes, slight hand wobble, paper or linen tooth.
cards.fragment: Contemporary minimalist gouache and ink on textured paper or coarse woven linen. Bold flat silhouettes densely patterned with hand-painted contour-following pinstripes and branching organic lines, subtle hand tremor and varied line spacing. Flat matte colour blocking, crisp graphic cut-out edges with organic imperfections, chalky dry-brush translucency inside dark fields, visible fibre tooth.

cards.name: Moonlit Storybook
cards.paint: Scraped-back matte layers, dry-brush scumbling and fine spatter; crisp shapes against a soft glow.
cards.fragment: Magical realism storybook painting in matte gouache and textured oil. Distressed surface with vertical scraped lines, dry-brush scumbling and delicate paint spatter flecks, aged layered-print quality. Sharp graphic silhouettes with subtle volumetric shading against a softly glowing circular light; extreme scale contrast between a tiny focal figure and a massive form.

cards.name: Hatched Mid-Century Folk
cards.paint: Flat opaque gouache with dry pencil hatching and linocut-like stripes; chalky, hand-pulled feel.
cards.fragment: Mid-century graphic gouache illustration on textured matte paper. Flat opaque fields with chalky cream stripe patterns, hand-drawn dry pencil hatching in vertical contoured strokes, sgraffito-style line drawing, crisp cut-out silhouettes with linocut-style imperfections, flat 2D perspective, minimal tonal shading, generous flat negative space.

cards.name: Palette Knife Planes
cards.paint: Thick paint pulled flat with a knife: raised ridges between colour facets, drag streaks.
cards.fragment: Heavy impasto oil and acrylic painting executed with wide flat palette-knife strokes and geometric colour blocking. Dense dimensional paint relief with sharp raised ridges between interlocking faceted planes, visible directional drag and scraping, subtle streaking of unmixed pigment, flat matte background quadrants.

cards.name: Flat Poster Block
cards.paint: Solid opaque shapes, sharp curved edges, no shading; real paper grain and slight misregistration.
cards.fragment: Mid-century minimalist graphic painting in flat opaque designer gouache with a screenprint feel on matte paper. Bold simplified curvilinear and geometric silhouettes, razor-sharp hard edges, solid colour fields with no gradients or shading, generous unbroken negative space. Hand-pulled print character: faint paper grain, slight ink density variation and a hair of edge misregistration, never vector-perfect.

cards.name: Ink Line + Spot Colour
cards.paint: Fine even black ink contours on warm paper, one bright spot colour as fills and stipple dots.
cards.fragment: Minimalist graphic screenprint illustration: crisp continuous black ink contour lines of even medium-thin weight on warm cream paper. Accents filled with a single punchy spot colour, as flat solid fills and fine stippled halftone dots. Hard clean edges, no gradients, expansive quiet negative space, refined retro editorial poster feel, faint paper grain.
